literal_meaning: মুখ (mouth) + ফোড় (burst or sore, implying harsh or bursting speech)
figurative_meaning_bn: দুর্মুখ; কাটা কাটা বলে; বাজে কথা বলে
figurative_meaning_en: foul-mouthed; speaks cuttingly or harshly; speaks rubbish or nonsense
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা মুখফোড় লোক, সবসময় গালাগালি করে।
মুখফোড়ের মতো কথা বলে সবাইকে আঘাত দিস না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a foul-mouthed person, always hurling abuses.
Don't speak like a sharp-tongued person and hurt everyone.
note: The idiom reflects colloquial Bengali expression for rude or abusive speech patterns common in everyday rural and urban interactions.
